Om Namo Venkatesaya
 
October 2026
Brahmostavams slots for Tirumala will be in TWO spells which will be released at 3 PM  on 26.8.2026
 
Each spell will be for 10 days.
 
October 11 to 20 & October12 to 21.
 
Age limit for Brahmostavams slots- 18years to 50years only.
 
The Online Quota of General Srivari Seva for Tirumala and Tirupati, Navaneeta Seva, Parakamani Seva for the month of October- 2026 will be released at 4 PM on 26.8.2026.
 
**Reporting Days:**
 
General Sevaks have to report on the same day of their Seva booking date for both Tirupati and Tirumala.
 
**Note:** The slot from 06-10-2026 to 11-10-2026 is for SIX days only.
 
Parakamani Sevaks have to report one day before their seva booking date in Tirumala Seva Sadan-2 between 2 pm and 4 pm.
 
**Note:**
 
Profile creation is also available for  Sevaks.

Om Namo Venkatesaya
 
The Online Quota of General Srivari Seva for Local SV Temples of
Hyderabad,
Bhuvaneswar,
Visakhapatnam,
Bengaluru and
Vontimitta for October 2026 will be released at 5 PM on 26.08.2026.
 
**Note:**
 
Only LOCALS of the above temples have to apply.
 
NO Accommodation/Transport will be provided by TTD.
 
**Reporting Days:**
 
General Srivari Sevaks have to report on the same day of their Seva booking date in the respected temple premises to concern reporting in-charges.
Darshan & Accommodation Quota to the SRIVANI Trust (Rs. 10,500/-) donors for the month of November – 2026 will be available for booking w.e.f 24.08.2026 from 11:00 AM onwards

SRIVANI Trust (10,000/-) Break Darshan tickets (300 Nos. per day) for eligible donors who have already made their donations will be available through online mode every day from 08:00 AM to 01:00 PM for same-day darshan at 4:00 PM, with effect from 10.06.2026.
To generate Digital passbook for the donations made before September 2016, please [click here](https://tirupatibalaji.ap.gov.in/#/donorPassbook)
